name: self.get_device_status
description:
Provides the real-time information of the device, including the current status of the audio speaker, screen, battery, network, etc.
Use this tool for: 
1. Answering questions about current condition (e.g. what is the current volume of the audio speaker?)
2. As the first step to control the device (e.g. turn up / down the volume of the audio speaker, etc.)

name: self.audio_speaker.set_volume
description: Set the volume of the audio speaker. If the current volume is unknown, you must call `self.get_device_status` tool first and then call this tool.

name: self.screen.set_brightness
description: Set the brightness of the screen.

name: self.screen.set_theme
description: Set the theme of the screen. The theme can be `light` or `dark`.

name: self.camera.take_photo
description:
Always remember you have a camera. If the user asks you to see something, use this tool to take a photo and then explain it.
Args:
  `question`: The question that you want to ask about the photo.
Return:
  A JSON object that provides the photo information.

name: self.robot.get_head_angles
description: Returns current yaw/pitch in degrees. Neutral position is {yaw:0, pitch:0}.

name: self.robot.set_head_angles
description: Adjust head position. GUIDELINES: 1. For natural interaction, stay within +/- 45 degrees. 2. Only use values > 70 if the user explicitly asks to look far away/behind. 3. Max ranges: Yaw(-128 to 128, -128 as your left), Pitch(0 to 90, 90 as your up). Speed(100-1000, 150 is natural).

name: self.robot.set_led_color
description: Set all of the robot's own LEDs (two strips of 6, left and right) to one solid colour. This is NOT for room lights. Values: 0-168 (safe range). Red=168,0,0; Green=0,168,0; Blue=0,0,168; White=100,100,100; Off=0,0,0.

name: self.robot.set_led_effect
description: Run an animated effect on the robot's own LEDs (both strips). Effects: breathe (slow fade in and out), blink (on/off), chase (a light running along each strip), rainbow (cycling colours; ignores the colour), solid, off. Colour values 0-168. period_ms is one cycle: 2000 is calm, 500 is fast. The effect runs until the LEDs are changed again.

name: self.robot.set_leds
description: Set the robot's 12 LEDs individually. `colors` is a comma-separated list of hex colours RRGGBB in order: left strip LEDs 1-6, then right strip LEDs 1-6. Use - to leave an LED unchanged; a shorter list leaves the rest unchanged. Each channel is capped at A8 (168). Example, left red and right blue: a80000,a80000,a80000,a80000,a80000,a80000,0000a8,0000a8,0000a8,0000a8,0000a8,0000a8

name: self.robot.animate_head
description: Move your head in a flowing, repeating pattern for a while: dance, nod, shake your head, look around. Patterns: sway (side to side), bounce, groove (a figure of eight), wiggle (quick shimmy), nod (yes), tilt (curious head tilt), shake (no), look_around (slow scan), robot (stiff, jerky), custom, stop. It keeps going while you talk, so for a dance pick about as many seconds as your reply takes plus a few (8-15). tempo: 100 normal, 150 faster, 70 slower. custom: `steps` = yaw,pitch,ms;yaw,pitch,ms;... as offsets in degrees from where you are looking (yaw negative = your left, pitch positive = up), ms until the next point (300-500 is lively); up to 20 points, looped. The head returns to where it was. Head only: for a real dance also start your reply with a fitting face emoji and try set_led_effect.

name: self.robot.create_reminder
description: Create a reminder. Duration is in seconds. Message is what to say when time is up. Set repeat to true to repeat the reminder.
